title: Transfer of boundary depth from a finite structure algebra to the source local rings
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $U\subseteq L$ open, and $\mathcal A$ a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_L$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Assume that for every $y\notin U$ its stalk $\mathcal A_y$, as a module over $\mathcal O_{L,y}$ through the stalk of its structure map, is finite and has depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $p:E\to L$ be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and supply an isomorphism $\alpha:\mathcal A\cong p_*\mathcal O_E$ of $\mathcal O_L$-algebras. Then $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{E,z}\geq2$ for every $z\in E$ with $p(z)\notin U$. No cover, etaleness, or depth hypothesis on the base local rings is required.

source.place: Tag 0AUK, applied to the finite direct image algebra as in the proof of Tag 0EY6(2)

proof.text: At a boundary point y choose an affine Noetherian neighbourhood Spec R. Its inverse image is Spec S with S finite over R. For q corresponding to y, the stalk of p_* O_E is the localization of S at R minus q. The algebra isomorphism alpha identifies this finite R_q-module with A_y and respects the action of R_q.

Points z of E over y correspond exactly to the maximal ideals of that finite R_q-algebra: finite maps are integral, and a prime over a maximal ideal is maximal. The source local ring O_E,z is its localization at the corresponding maximal ideal.

Apply Tag 0AUK with N equal to the finite R_q-algebra itself. Its depth as an R_q-module is the minimum of the depths of the localizations at these maximal ideals. The supplied lower bound therefore holds for every such local ring. A zero algebra stalk has no points above it, so the conclusion there is vacuous.

theorem depth_two_of_finite_structure_algebra
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    (A : L.CommAlgebraSheaf)
    (hdepth : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      letI : Algebra (L.presheaf.stalk y)
            ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).obj A.right.obj) :=
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).map A.hom.hom).hom.toAlgebra
      ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite (L.presheaf.stalk y)
            ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).obj A.right.obj),
        letI := hfinite
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y)
            ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).obj A.right.obj))
    {E : Scheme.{u}} (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite p]
    (α : A ≅ Under.mk
      (⟨p.c⟩ : L.sheaf ⟶ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} p.base).obj E.sheaf)) :
    ∀ z : E, p z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z)
